name: Sýn hf.
summary: Sýn hf. provides communication and media service in Iceland. The company operates radio station under the Bylgjan, FM957, and Xið names; and Stöð 2, a subscription-based television network. It also offers video streaming and advertisement services. The company was formerly known as Fjarskipti hf. and changed its name to Sýn hf. in April 2018. Sýn hf. is headquartered in Reykjavík, Iceland.
